hero.title:
Hi, I AM
UBAYDULLAYEV SHAMSIDDIN.
hero.description:
Hi! My name is Shamsiddin, I’m 17 years old, and I’m from Uzbekistan. I'm
passionate about IT and determined to build my future in this field. I already have solid
skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, which allow me to create responsive and modern web
layouts.

work.text:
Here are some of the selected projects that showcase my passion for
front-end development.
work.title:
Promotional landing page for our
favorite show
work.features:
Teamed up with a designer to breathe life into a promotional webpage
for our beloved show, Adventure Time. Delivered a fully responsive
design with dynamic content capabilities, seamlessly integrating a
newsletter feature to keep fans updated with the latest adventures.

blog.title: Blog site for World News
blog.text:
Mastered CSS Grid complexities in building an innovative news
homepage, navigating intricate design decisions for a seamless user
experience. Leveraged the challenge to enhance skills in front-end
development.

product.title: E-commerce product page
product.text:
Successfully crafted an engaging product page featuring a dynamic
lightbox gallery and seamless cart functionality, showcasing
proficiency in JavaScript development.
product.features:
This project was built using both front-end and back-end technologies
and represents my first real professional website, showcasing
practical experience in full-stack development.

about.title: ABOUT ME
about.text: I am a front-end developer based in Tashkent. Has Mechanical Engineering background.
about.subtext:
In addition to programming, I actively work on my personal development — I
study English, mathematics, and enjoy playing football. My dream is to enter a high-quality
international university that focuses on IT, where I can deepen my knowledge and grow as a
professional.

My strengths include discipline, responsibility, optimism, and hard work. My ultimate goal is to
become a recognized expert in the IT industry and contribute to the development of my country.

skills.title: MY CAPABILITIES
skills.text: I am always looking to add more skills.

freelance.title: Freelance Developer
freelance.text: I began studying IT in 2023 and quickly developed a strong interest in web development. Since then, I have created over 10 projects using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. These projects reflect my continuous growth, attention to responsive design, and a passion for building clean and dynamic user interfaces.

intern.title: Front-End Intern
intern.text: During this internship, I participated in a Demo Day where I had the opportunity to present a fully developed website live on stage. The event required not only technical skills but also confidence and communication, as I showcased my ability to build a complete website from scratch in front of an audience.

achievements.title: My achievements
achievements.text: Beyond my focus on IT, I actively engaged in community service and extracurricular activities. I volunteered in various initiatives, such as assisting the elderly and contributing to environmental projects by planting trees and other greenery. I also took part in sports activities, including regular morning runs, which helped me build discipline and resilience. In addition, I frequently supported my school by participating in events and providing assistance whenever needed.
